## Change

**`src/components/AsyncPanel.tsx`**
- Added an `attempt` counter alongside the existing `state`. The polling effect is now keyed on `attempt`: it still uses the same 120 ms simulated delay and reads `?sync=error` only on the initial attempt, so the first load behaves exactly as before (error at `/?sync=error`, success at `/`), while a retry always resolves to success.
- `retry()` sets the state back to `'loading'` (rendering `Checking service…`) and increments `attempt`; the effect's existing `clearTimeout` cleanup guarantees at most one live timer, so repeated activation cannot overlap timers, and unmount still clears it.
- Rendered `Retry sync` as a `type="button"` inside the existing error block, so it exists only in the error state, disappears on success, does no navigation/reload, and — since `AsyncPanel` keeps its own local state — cannot reset the selected task in `App`.

**`src/styles.css`**
- Added `.sync-retry { justify-self: start; margin-top: 8px; }` so the new button keeps the shared `button` styling but isn't stretched full-width by the error block's grid layout.

## Commands run

- `npm run verify:agent` — which runs `npm run build` (`tsc --noEmit && vite build`) and `npm run test:public` (`playwright test`). Both green: build succeeded, 6/6 public tests passed.

## Remaining risks

- Retry behavior itself is covered only by manual reasoning; the public suite has no error/retry test, and I did not add tests (task forbade modifying existing ones, and none were requested).
- A retry always succeeds by design; there is no path back to the error state after the first attempt. If a hidden test expects the query param to be re-read on retry, that would fail — but the acceptance criteria state retry completes as synced, so this matches the spec.
- The retry button inherits the `button:focus-visible` outline and is inside the existing `role="alert"` region; `aria-live="polite"` behavior on the parent is unchanged.

- `retry()` sets the state back to `'loading'` (rendering `Checking service…`) and increments `attempt`; the effect's existing `clearTimeout` cleanup guarantees at most one live timer, so repeated activation cannot overlap timers, and unmount still clears it.
- Rendered `Retry sync` as a `type="button"` inside the existing error block, so it exists only in the error state, disappears on success, does no navigation/reload, and — since `AsyncPanel` keeps its own local state — cannot reset the selected task in `App`.

**`src/styles.css`**
- Added `.sync-retry { justify-self: start; margin-top: 8px; }` so the new button keeps the shared `button` styling but isn't stretched full-width by the error block's grid layout.

## Commands run

- `npm run verify:agent` — which runs `npm run build` (`tsc --noEmit && vite build`) and `npm run test:public` (`playwright test`). Both green: build succeeded, 6/6 public tests passed.

## Remaining risks

- Retry behavior itself is covered only by manual reasoning; the public suite has no error/retry test, and I did not add tests (task forbade modifying existing ones, and none were requested).
